pages.title: Specific languages
pages.description: Set up the SharePoint app in Teams experience in a specific language
pages.about: This page explains how to configure the SharePoint app in Microsoft Teams for a specific language. It covers setting up the experience for organizations with or without a SharePoint home site, configuring the Teams dashboard, news feed, and resources web part across 27 supported languages.
